title: 按搭建顺序写分镜
content: 写分镜时让剧情推进与布景搭建顺序同步：把影片前段动作安排在先搭好的三四个景中，使布景随人物塑造一起递进，避免为等景而打乱拍摄顺序。
quote: the early action of the picture takes place in the first three or four settings erected

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 暗示优于复制
content: 场景营造采用暗示与联想的手法，而非对现实的原样复制；这一原则适用于包括电影在内的多种艺术。
quote: It is the principle of creating something by implication and suggestion rather than actual reproduction.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 示范式指导已被淘汰
content: 坚持亲自演遍每个角色的导演正逐渐被逐出片场，如今已很少见，且数量继续减少，淘汰后影片质量会更好。
quote: This method has gradually been forced out of the studio.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 心理戏压掉夸张情节
content: 处理以真实心理发展为核心的故事时，应把人为的通俗剧式煽情与浮夸英雄气概压到几乎不可察觉，或干脆全部删除。
quote: The artificial melodramatics and blatant heroics he subdues to unnoticeable effect or more often eliminates entirely.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 用情绪弧定位角色处境
content: 处理具体场景时，先确定该场戏落在情绪弧的哪个点（如A点=痛苦），再据此选择演员的表演强度与调度方式，而不是只按情节字面处理。
quote: Say that the line and point A represent the emotion of suffering.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 写实处理反失真实
content: 处理异域或特殊场所（如布宜诺斯艾利斯河岸酒馆）时，若按字面写实还原，效果反而不够真实；可大胆加工以取得更强的色彩与氛围。
quote: yet had I been literal in the way I handled it the effect would not have been anything nearly as realistic

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 爱情戏为何最易拍真
content: 处理爱情/浪漫场面时，导演往往只以自身恋爱经验为唯一点，不向外类比，因此浪漫戏在银幕上最常被拍得真实到位；可借这种自我确信来调度浪漫戏。
quote: Consequently there is no line C, but just the point. It is stationary.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 角色须彼此区分
content: 完美影片中每个角色必须鲜明地与其他角色区分开，具有独立个性；这种区分只能靠让每位演员自行诠释角色来实现。
quote: In the perfect photoplay each character must be distinctly itself.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 导演示范表演的弊端
content: 导演亲自把每个角色演一遍、要求演员模仿自己的动作与表情，会让全片变成导演一人的复制品，演员失去个性，成片呆板、不自然、无特色；应避免这种示范式指导。
quote: In the end all the players gave bad imitations of the director.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 情绪经验决定导演能力
content: 导演的创作能力取决于其情绪经验的广度：把人生中每种情绪（如痛苦、牺牲、爱）还原为具体而平凡的基本点，在情绪弧上占据的点越多，越能胜任指导表演与场面。
quote: The more points of emotion upon the director's arc, the better craftsman he is.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 画面感是导演核心能力
content: 导演的核心能力是画面感/视觉化能力，即把文字剧本转化为具体可拍画面的能力；缺乏此能力者即使在本行是艺术家也常在导演领域失败。
quote: who have failed because of this lack of picture sense, lack of the ability to visualize.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 导演需具备表演能力
content: 导演若懂表演，可在排练中亲自示范或替演角色，帮助演员理解走位与情绪；选导演时把表演经验视为加分项。
quote: a knowledge of acting, or rather a knowledge of how to act, comes in very handy from the director's point of view.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 情绪弧线外推法
content: 导演要演一个比自己经历更强烈的情绪（如拿破仑的失败之痛）时，以自身情绪经验弧上的对应点为A，把A向外延伸，直到与角色情绪弧相交，用交点作为表演强度的参照。
quote: He then merely extends the line A out and beyond his own emotional arc until it crosses the emotional arc of Napoleon

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 情绪参照是潜意识过程
content: 导演调用自身情绪经验来定表演强度，多数是机械且潜意识的，未必自觉；因此不必要求导演显式写出情绪曲线，但结果仍受此机制支配。
quote: The whole working out of the scheme is mechanical and subconscious to a certain extent.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 情绪记忆需长期沉淀
content: 强烈情绪经历（如极度痛苦）会在意识或潜意识中长期留存，导演应在创作时主动调用这些沉淀记忆，而非依赖即时情绪。
quote: this experience of acute suffering remains stamped, consciously or subconsciously, on the individual's mind.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 跳拍下的情绪连续性
content: 当制片计划要求先拍第81场再拍第21场时，导演必须在半小时内切换跨越两年的情绪状态；拍摄前先明确每场戏在故事中的相对情绪位置，避免用上一场的情绪惯性带入下一场。
quote: He must live two years in half an hour or less.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 弱情绪向下延伸
content: 当要拍的情绪比导演自身经历更轻微（如小男孩结巴念第一课），把A线向下延伸至角色情绪弧，用较低强度处理，不要一律拉满。
quote: the line A is merely extended downward until the little boy's emotional arc is reached

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 多机位同拍全景与特写
content: 把同一场景搭成可同时从不同角度、不同距离拍摄的结构，让演员一次演完整场戏时，全景、中近景、特写由多台摄影机同时拍下，省去事后移机移灯补特写的时间与情绪损耗。
keywords: 多机位同拍全景与特写
quote: he can photograph them from different angles and from different distances at the same time

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 以亲历经验还原囚禁戏
content: 拍拿破仑被囚圣赫勒拿这类场景时，导演应调用自身最接近的受困/痛苦记忆（如寒夜露宿、被世界抛弃的体验）来设计角色的身体状态与情绪，使表演有真实依据。
quote: The director is called upon to stage, we will say, the scene of Napoleon, a prisoner of the European powers on the island of St. Helena.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 动作戏需预演受击反应
content: 拍摄击倒类动作戏时，必须提前与演员确认受击倒地的表演配合；若演员拒绝按剧本倒地，应改用替身或由对手实际击倒完成镜头。
quote: when it came time for him to be knocked out he just wouldn't fall down.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 只讲做什么不讲怎么做
content: 指导演员时只告诉他要做什么（WHAT），不示范具体怎么做（HOW），把创作细节交给演员的智能去完成，以保留表演的自主性。
quote: “Never show them HOW but tell them WHAT” is his formula.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 分镜与即兴的取舍
content: 按分镜拍摄等于执行编剧的构思，省力但缺乏创作快感；不按分镜拍摄则导演在拍摄过程中自行创造，代价是可能走错路、需要反复试错。
quote: He believes that the man who works directly from a continuity is merely carrying out the plans of the scenario writer.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 连续拍摄优于分切
content: 按剧情顺序连续拍摄整场戏，比先拍全景再补特写的方式更利于保持导演与演员的情绪状态，成片效果更好。
quote: This step of producing pictures in continuity is a big one and one in the right direction.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 顺拍法适用条件
content: 按剧情顺序（continuity）拍摄适用于以表演和叙事为主的影片；当影片核心是肢体动作与惊险刺激时，顺拍会浪费时间，应改用按镜头拆拍的方式。
quote: this method would not apply to the director working on the “action” picture

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 顺场次拍摄保表演连贯
content: 按场次编号从第1场顺序拍到结尾，而非按场景或演员档期跳拍；这样演员的角色塑造能逐日累积、保持连贯，导演也能看着故事逐日成形、对整体走向把握更准。
quote: The method of starting with scene No. 1 and proceeding numerically to the conclusion of the picture is of benefit to both players and director.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 勿让配角模仿主角
content: 排练时不要让配角逐段模仿主角的表演，否则成片会变成一个好主角加一堆劣质模仿；配角应保持各自表演，而非复制主角。
quote: One good Charles Chaplin and a dozen bad imitations of Charles Chaplin.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 氛围求效果非写实
content: 搭景与布光的目标是传达导演想要的气氛效果，而非照搬现实环境；若把真实场景原样搬上银幕往往缺乏说服力，应通过暗示与联想创造氛围。
quote: the aim of the director should be to get over the _effect_ of the atmosphere he desires, rather than the actual atmosphere which exists

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 即兴拍摄的节奏收益
content: 放弃预先分镜时，导演因不知道下一段会发生什么而保持探索感，成片即便技术上有瑕疵也不沉闷、始终新鲜；这是即兴方法在节奏与观感上的收益。
quote: his experiences even though at times poor with respect to picture technique, are never tedious but always refreshing.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 摄影经验转化为调度力
content: 有长期跟机位经验（如摄影助理出身）的人，因已把视觉化练到高程度，可直接上手执导；其优势在于对画面构成的直觉判断。
quote: This man was a cameraman, had worked on a hundred pictures and, having the power to visualize, had developed it to a remarkable degree.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 替演排练加速拍摄
content: 演员迟到或缺席时，导演可亲自替演其角色完成整场排练，使其他演员保持投入；待演员到场后只需一次简短排练即可开机。
quote: When at last she did appear the scene only needed one brief rehearsal before the cameras started to grind.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 特写机藏于布景后
content: 用于拍特写的摄影机应隐蔽在合适的布景片后方（遮黑处理），使演员不被额外机位干扰，保持长场戏的表演连贯。
quote: The closeups cameras are “blinded” behind convenient pieces of scenery.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 模仿动作不自然
content: 若导演示范如何拿起纸张或书本，演员会刻意模仿；对导演自然的动作对演员可能别扭，模仿结果至多是导演的拙劣复制。
quote: what may be perfectly natural for me may be unnatural and awkward for him

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 自大反推会失真
content: 若导演认为自己的痛苦远大于角色，就会把A线反向向下推去够角色情绪弧；这种自负的取法不会得到最佳结果，应避免以自我为上限。
quote: Such conceit on the part of the director does not, however, lead to the best results.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 跳拍破坏角色弧线
content: 若按4、11、44这类场次编号跳拍，无法形成一致、完整、心理上层层上升的角色；因此以角色发展为核心的戏必须避免跳拍。
quote: Really artistic results could never be secured with this eternal jumping from 4 to 11 to 44, they said.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 导演口述故事代替剧本
content: 若演员拿到完整分镜脚本会误解角色，导演应亲自口述故事并加入角色塑造与氛围的细节，使演员理解与导演意图一致，减少误解与争论。
quote: Given the continuity an actor may get quite the wrong idea of the role he is to play.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 轻喜剧最易拍好
content: 若要在有限能力下保证成片质量，优先选择轻浪漫/轻喜剧题材，它是各类影片中最容易拍、也最容易拍好的类型。
quote: As yet he has only attempted light romance on the screen, the easiest sort of picture to produce and to produce well as has been pointed out.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 情绪弧线要填满细节
content: 角色的情绪体验弧线应被尽可能多的细腻层次填满，而不是只靠几个强烈动作点支撑。
quote: His arc of emotional experience is filled, it is more than obvious, with all the sensitive lines imaginable.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 情感跨度决定导演上限
content: 评估一个导演的高度，要看他是否被调用过完整的情感跨度；只拍过单一轻松类型时，其真实能力仍是未知量，不能据此定论。
quote: As yet his real emotional gamut has not been brought into play. It is an unknown quantity.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 场次相对价值要记牢
content: 跳拍时导演需在脑中保持整条故事线与各场次相对价值的清晰排序，判断每场戏在整体中的轻重，不能因拍摄顺序打乱而混淆场次权重。
quote: To keep his whole story and the comparative values of certain sequences straight in his mind, is no easy matter.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 选角优先外形贴合
content: 选角时优先选择外形与角色高度吻合的演员，例如让退役拳手出演拳手角色，外形贴合可减少观众对角色的认知成本。
quote: He looked the part to perfection.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 演员理解力决定沟通方式
content: 采用口述故事法需以演员具备普遍理解力与表演能力为前提；若演员经验不足，应改用更明确的现场指令而非依赖口述。
quote: Mr. De Mille is fortunate in having players of general intelligence and ability to deal with.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 节奏错位毁整段
content: 一段喜剧序列若整体放慢节奏，会使其脱节并不可修复地削弱银幕效果；同理，在错误位置加速也会造成同等灾难性后果。
quote: A slight slowing down in tempo may throw an entire comedy sequence out of gear, so to speak, and irreparably weaken its effect on the screen.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 避免道具符号单一化
content: 不要把香烟等道具只与反派绑定；若反派摆弄香烟就代表邪恶，这种符号过于直白且危险，应让道具使用多样化。
quote: the practice of directors in identifying cigarettes solely with villains

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 相邻段落做微差节奏
content: 两段相邻戏的节奏可以只差毫厘，但必须仍有差别；这点细微差异会累积成观众对影片戏剧价值的潜意识感受。
quote: there is little more than a hair's breadth in tempo but little as it is it is still there

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 固定座位重复摆位
content: 为强化仪式化、静态的群像感，可让同一组人物在每场戏中固定坐在相同座位、保持相同姿态，像反复为画家或摄影师摆姿势。
quote: in each scene, they appear fixed in the same seats, as if posing repeatedly for a painter or photographer

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 时段与街道选择服务氛围
content: 为营造写实氛围，可将场景安排在傍晚、选行人稀少的街道拍摄；但需注意该时段仍可能有零星行人经过，应把他们纳入群众调度或提前清场。
quote: The time chosen to take the scene was late afternoon and a little frequented street was selected for the occasion.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 战后转向表面提问
content: 二战后风格的镜头：把注意力放在影像表面本身，组织画面回答“影像表面上有什么可看”，而非追问背后的隐藏含义。
quote: “What is there to see on the surface of the image?” – a transition that “changed all the relations between cinematic images.”

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 原始自然景与模仿命题
content: 使用原始自然场景时，可让其承担艺术与自然关系的提问，即围绕“艺术模仿自然”这一古典命题展开，而非仅作背景。
quote: the primordial natural settings in Kiarostami’s films, in a sense, pose the question of art and nature in regard to the notion of imitation

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 机关道具保密原则
content: 使用机械装置完成特技或喜剧效果时，对实现方法保密，让观众保持惊奇感，比公开手法更能维持观影满足。
quote: He works on the principle that the public is better satisfied by remaining mystified

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 先定机位角度再布光
content: 先确定本场第一个镜头的拍摄角度，让摄影指导按此架机；导演需在脑中预演该角度下画面在胶片上的效果，再决定是否调整。
quote: The cameraman has been told from what angle you are going to “shoot” the scene first and has “set up” his machine according to his own likes.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 规则皆有例外
content: 关于导演不宜兼任编剧/剪辑的规则并非绝对，允许存在个别例外；判断时应按具体项目与创作者状态取舍，而非机械套用。
quote: The rule is like every other rule and wouldn't be a rule unless there were here and there an exception to it.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 小聚光灯突出主角
content: 决定是否用小聚光灯（spots）单独打亮主角，使其在画面中最占优势；若使用，灯位同样必须摆正。
quote: And are you going to use any of the smaller “spots” to offset your star to the best advantage? These must also be in the right place.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 场面调度的构成要素
content: 分析或设计场面调度时，需同时考虑灯光、服装、布景、道具、演员的空间安排，以及演员间距、手势与走位形成的视觉图案。
quote: mise-en-scène includes the spatial arrangement of lighting, costume, décor, properties, and actors

source_ref.title: Blurring Space Across Film, Theatre and Virtual Reality: Zero Calorie Restaurant (2023)
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 拟像三秩序
content: 分析电影空间模仿时，可依据鲍德里亚的三种拟像秩序：仿造秩序、生产秩序、模拟秩序，分别对应文艺复兴、工业化与二战后消费主义时期。
quote: identifying three historical “orders of simulacra”: the order of the counterfeit, the order of production, and the order of simulation.

source_ref.title: Blurring Space Across Film, Theatre and Virtual Reality: Zero Calorie Restaurant (2023)
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 分镜编剧用画面思考
content: 分镜编剧必须用画面思考：写作过程中持续在脑中预演，完成时脑中已是一部完整影片，纸上也对应一部完整影片。
quote: The continuity writer thinks in pictures. If he is efficient he is able to visualize his work as he goes along.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 花钱堆场面非好片之道
content: 判断一部影片好坏不能靠砸钱做奢华布景和堆砌群众；若故事的个人/人物元素未被严肃对待、不真实可信，再大的场面也救不了影片。
quote: a picture can be made good by throwing a lot of money away on lavish settings, and settings containing a lot of people

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 用画面暗示情境
content: 单幅画面（剧照/定格）应能暗示出人物所处的情境，即通过构图与人物关系让观众读出正在发生什么，而不依赖对白说明。
quote: HERE IS A STILL THAT ILLUSTRATES REX INGRAM'S ABILITY TO SUGGEST A SITUATION

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 绘画性画面提升类型片
content: 即使是通俗情节剧题材，也应在画面中注入绘画性构图与美术处理，用视觉艺术把类型片提升到更高层次。
quote: These he endowed too with all the art at his command and so lifted melodrama to a higher plane than it ever reached before.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 不丢失个人故事线
content: 即便处理宏大题材或群像场面，导演也必须始终抓住属于个人的那条故事线，不让场面规模淹没人物。
quote: REX INGRAM NEVER LOST TRACK OF HIS PERSONAL STORY IN “THE FOUR HORSEMEN”

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 蜿蜒路径与孤树母题
content: 反复使用蜿蜒小径、基本元素母题与孤树作为固定取景装置（dispositif），让同一空间元素在不同段落中重复出现，以重复而非变化来承载转变。
quote: Kiarostami’s recurrent dispositif – the serpentine paths, elemental motifs, and solitary trees

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 重复信号与凝视停留
content: 反复出现的影像信号应设计成让观众'停留在其上'而非'穿过它'，即用重复阻断推进感，把注意力固定在当下的画面质感上。
quote: to concentrate on them, but not go through them

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 喜剧噱头需持续更新
content: 喜剧段落设计噱头时，应避免依赖扔馅饼这类陈旧 gag，改用更新鲜、更有趣的动作设计；旧 gag 至多偶尔使用以作怀旧点缀。
quote: The throwing of a pie was ceased long since as a comedy “gag” by the high class slapstick directors. Other “gags” have replaced it.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 导演把控喜剧表演
content: 喜剧演员的银幕效果高度依赖导演把控：同一演员脱离导演指导自组公司后往往失败，说明喜剧表演需由导演统一调度节奏与分寸。
quote: Certainly in his case direction enters into his success largely.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 意外反转制造爆笑
content: 喜剧笑点可用意外反转制造：先按观众预期铺垫（如跳桥自杀），再让结果与预期完全相反（水仅一英尺深，人猛然停住），笑果比常规铺垫更强。
quote: The element of surprise enters into the making of the modern comedy to a great extent.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 第二肖像的竞争性构图
content: 在主体人物之外，于画面内（如床头柜）放置第二个人像/肖像，与主体形成竞争性的构图对话，分散并重组视觉重心。
quote: the insistent presence of the Virgin Mary’s image on the bedside table introduces a second, competing portrait

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 不祥音乐提示潜在危机
content: 在人物离场等关键节点铺不祥的音乐提示，用声音强调“随时可能出事”的悬念。
quote: At the end of the movie I use an ominous music cue when he leaves the coliseum to underline the idea that something can always happen.

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 内外螺旋运动达成圆融
content: 在内部与外部、自我与世界之间做递归的螺旋式往返运动，以此作为段落收束方式，达成圆融的存在状态。
quote: a state achieved through the recursive, spiraling movement between interior and exterior, self and world

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 用细节打断壮观场面
content: 在宏大壮观场面中插入小孩与小猫玩耍这类细小私人化细节，是格里菲斯式的正确做法；导演不应为追求场面规模而牺牲故事中的人物元素，人物必须被拍得可信、真实。
quote: he will stop a spectacular scene now and then to show a youngster playing with kittens

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 液化主题的视觉动作收束
content: 在影片结尾用与“液化”相关的具体动作（往挡风玻璃泼水、把骨头抛入溪流）把主题落实为可见的图形位置。
quote: Behzad throws a bucket of water onto his car’s windshield and casts the thighbone into a stream

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 孤树作空间锚点
content: 在蜿蜒道路的段落里，把一棵孤树放在山丘顶点或道路尽头作为空间标记，用它同时标示起点与终点，使反复出现的旅程在画面上有可辨认的参照物。
quote: not only differentiates the landscape and marks hills’ summit and the end of the serpentine road

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 个人故事嵌入奇观背景
content: 处理奇观题材时，把个人化的故事线嵌入宏大背景之中，使私人叙事与壮观场面相互衬托，而不是让奇观场面单独堆砌。
quote: he is a master of blending the personal story with the spectacular background.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 内外空间循环调度
content: 处理室内与室外关系时，不要做单向的进出，而让镜头在内外两个空间之间反复往返、呈螺旋式回归，使空间转换本身成为结构而非一次性事件。
quote: there is a constant circular – eventually spiralling movement – between these two spaces of being, a winding path of recurrences

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 此世内的他界
content: 处理超验性空间时，不另设一个高于现实的世界，而是把“他界”叠加、嫁接在此世之内，用同一场景承载双重空间。
quote: “the imaginal world names the ‘other world’ within this one.”

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 转变用缓慢迂回呈现
content: 处理转变/转化时不要给解决式收束，而用缓慢、迂回的镜头运动与剪辑，让固态与流动、差异与重复持续交替。
quote: rendering transformation not as resolution but as a slow, circuitous interplay between solidity and fluidity, difference and repetition

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 可视化能力审稿
content: 审阅分镜时须具备高度可视化能力：逐点讨论故事及其在分镜写作中的展开方式，把文字稿在脑中预演成画面再判断取舍。
quote: Equipped with the power of visualization to a remarkable degree Mr. Ince and his production manager thoroughly scrutinize the continuity

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 导演需保持观众视角
content: 导演在剧本、拍摄、剪辑每个环节都要跳出自己，以普通观众的立场重看素材；因为观众只看一次且事先不知道故事，凡是有价值的剧情点都必须保留，否则会剪掉关键信息。
quote: the director must jump outside himself and view his picture from the standpoint of the layman every time that he has anything to do with it.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 打破银幕刻板印象
content: 导演应主动改变剧本与审查造成的虚假惯例（如舞厅女郎必纯洁、慈母必织毛衣），可循序渐进但必须着手改变，避免角色类型化。
quote: the director is the lucky fellow that has it in his power to change them. Let him go about his task gradually if he so wishes, but let him go about it.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 节奏需精确到分秒
content: 导演应把节奏控制做到接近实用科学的程度：先判断某段戏的价值，再以分、秒为单位算出其时长。
quote: To gauge the value of a certain sequence and then to think it out in minutes and seconds

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 导演是再创作者
content: 导演的定位是把已完成的剧本从文字媒介转译为影像媒介，属于再创作而非原创；分镜阶段应把剧本视为既定素材，用镜头语言重新组织，而不是重写故事。
quote: Deprived of the privilege of calling himself a creator, a director can at last call himself a recreator.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 人性观察是导演核心
content: 导演须对普通人的共通生活有深切体认，能体察人性并把人的真实面反映到银幕上，才可能成功。
quote: the director's appreciation of the human side of life is his greatest asset.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 沉浸与排除的悖论
content: 将观众沉浸于视觉化空间的同时，也会将他们排除在所模仿的生活现实之外；设计沉浸式空间时需意识到这种双重效果。
quote: immersing audiences in visualised spaces simultaneously exclude them from the lived realities these spaces imitate.

source_ref.title: Blurring Space Across Film, Theatre and Virtual Reality: Zero Calorie Restaurant (2023)
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 前景虚化建立空间层次
content: 开场用特写拍餐桌局部时，把刀叉等道具放在镜头前景并做虚化处理，让中景人物（如即将进食的女子）保持清晰，用虚实差建立前后景深与空间层次。
quote: a close-up reveals two pairs of hands holding knives and forks, with a blurred effect in the camera’s foreground

source_ref.title: Blurring Space Across Film, Theatre and Virtual Reality: Zero Calorie Restaurant (2023)
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 开拍前检查布景细节
content: 开拍前先扫视整个布景确认是否就绪，包括道具桌上是否积灰、道具是否被遗忘未撤；导演必须亲自过问这类小细节，不能交给场务默认处理。
quote: Perhaps dust has accumulated on the library table over night and perhaps again the property boy has forgotten to remove it.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 排练前先检查妆造
content: 开拍前逐一检查演员妆造是否与角色匹配（如女仆口红过重、眼妆不足），发现不符立即让其回化妆间修改，再开始排练。
quote: Is this girl who is to do the “bit” of the maid all right? No, you decide, she has too much rouge on her lips and not enough mascara about the eyes.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 惊险场面的独立拍摄
content: 当一部影片需要制造惊险高潮（如骑马跃过深谷）时，可把该镜头交给擅长特技的专门导演与摄影棚单独拍摄，再剪入主线；其余文戏由原导演负责，两段素材在剪辑点对接。
quote: Neither Miss Stewart, nor Marshall Neilan, who directed all the rest of “In Old Kentucky” had anything to do with this particular scene.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 环形旅程替代线性目标
content: 当主角有明确线性目标时，让叙事路径反复回到原点、把目的地叠加在出发地上，用循环结构取代直线抵达，使旅程本身成为主题。
quote: the narratives force them into circular paths, superimposing destination on origin, the elsewhere onto the same.

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 各元素平衡优先于单一效果
content: 当作者、美术（布景）与戏剧场面三者冲突时，导演应追求三者的平衡与融合，不得为画面效果牺牲戏剧场面，也不得反过来为戏剧场面牺牲画面背景。
quote: are in the end spoiled by a lack of the proper balance and blending of all the elements that go to make the picture.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 监制统一调度多组
content: 当制片方设多个摄制组时，由总制片导演对各组导演行使实际监督权，组导演须执行其指令，以保证多线风格与质量统一。
quote: He has a certain number of directors making pictures for him. Over the work of these men he exercises an actual supervision.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 靠身体状态判断时序
content: 当同一场景反复出现、时间位置不明时，可让观众仅通过人物身体状态（如疲态、伤痕）来推断该段落在时间线上的位置。
quote: the viewer can discern its temporal placement only by observing the protagonists’ physical state

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 暴露特效原理破坏幻觉
content: 当同一演员同框出现等特效（如二次曝光）的拍摄原理被观众熟知后，画面一出现观众就会跳出剧情、意识到摄影机制，幻觉失效；因此这类特效镜头应避免让观众预先知道其实现方式，或改用不易被识破的手法。
quote: As a result of all the publicity given the subject of double exposure its use to create a real illusion has practically passed.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 超真实空间的定义
content: 当场景由不存在的符号或能指集合构成时，即进入超真实状态；此时真实与人工空间的界限被模糊，可用于设计非现实或混合现实的空间呈现。
quote: hyperreality creates a state in which the distinction between genuine and artificial becomes blurred

source_ref.title: Blurring Space Across Film, Theatre and Virtual Reality: Zero Calorie Restaurant (2023)
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 导演兼任编剧的弊端
content: 当导演同时承担编剧与分镜/剪辑工作时，容易因长期沉浸而失去判断：会默认观众与自己同样熟悉素材，从而省略必要交代、忽视缺陷、放大自认的优点，成片往往平淡、机械、缺乏艺术性。因此分镜与剪辑应尽量交由他人把关。
quote: They know it so well that they think everyone else is on the same familiar footing with it.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 自编自导的双重身份
content: 当导演把自己写的文字作品转成影像时，他同时占据创作者与再创作者两个位置；但他在编剧环节的原创性并不自动延续到导演环节，分镜与调度仍需独立设计。
quote: the fact that he is creating in one of his capacities, doesn't mean that he is creating in the other as well.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 仿造秩序下的银幕空间
content: 当影片空间依赖戏剧性模仿或拟真传统时，其呈现方式属于鲍德里亚所说的"仿造秩序"；此处的"戏剧性"指银幕上以电影语言实现的虚构式模仿，而非文艺复兴舞台实践。
quote: The representation of space in cinema that draws on theatricality or mimetic traditions often resonates with this order.

source_ref.title: Blurring Space Across Film, Theatre and Virtual Reality: Zero Calorie Restaurant (2023)
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 生活化巧合可作素材
content: 当情节被指为“太巧”时，可用现实依据辩护：日常与新闻中巧合频发，因此把真实生活中的巧合情境搬上银幕是成立的，不必刻意回避。
quote: Coincidence runs rife in the life of everyone.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 孤立即圆形构图
content: 当画面中某物被孤立出来时，让它成为自我集中的圆形中心：以该物为圆心组织周围景物（如天空成穹顶），使孤立元素获得向心的构图重量。
quote: when a thing becomes isolated, it becomes round, assumes a figure of being that is concentrated upon itself

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 文化符号引导观众入戏
content: 当画面写实元素极少时，靠观众解读文化编码的身体符号来建立空间与情境，而非靠布景信息；分镜应把镜头留给可被识别的程式化动作，而不是补充环境细节。
quote: the audience is drawn into the scene by interpreting culturally coded bodily signs

source_ref.title: Blurring Space Across Film, Theatre and Virtual Reality: Zero Calorie Restaurant (2023)
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 生产秩序与机械复制
content: 当空间呈现从模仿转向机械复制时，进入"生产秩序"：系列化复制使对象成为可互换的拟像，表现问题由此从"生产什么"转为"如何被中介与感知"。
quote: The second order, the order of production, marks a shift from imitation to mechanical reproduction.

source_ref.title: Blurring Space Across Film, Theatre and Virtual Reality: Zero Calorie Restaurant (2023)
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 预兆性静默的用法
content: 当需要制造不祥预感时，采用与“非在场”对应的静默：抽掉一切安抚性声音，让静默成为不祥的空洞，而非单纯的安静。
quote: this silence could be defined as foreboding, the kind associated with non-presence

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 演员即兴救场保镜头
content: 当非职业路人闯入镜头并干扰表演时，可由演员在角色内即兴用台词或动作将其驱离，从而在不喊停、不切镜的情况下保住整段连续镜头。
quote: When two people bent over him and offered assistance, he angrily told them to be on their ways.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 领先观众但不过远
content: 影片的表达只能比观众认知超前几步，用这几步引导观众跟上，不能超出太远；超前幅度过大会失去观众。
quote: It can keep a few paces ahead and encourage its audiences to come up those few paces but it can't go too far afield.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 分镜准备需长期打磨
content: 德米尔兄弟的做法是：在分镜准备阶段投入长时间而艰苦的工作；英斯的方法则把分镜的重要性置于一切之上，说明分镜准备应被当作最重的工序。
quote: Both the De Milles are frank with the statement that they work long and arduously over the preparation of their continuities.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 构图能力可独立于导演
content: 戏剧导演能力与构图能力是两种可分离的素养：一个人可以是出色的戏剧导演却完全不懂构图，因此选人时不要把二者视为同一项能力。
quote: A man might be perfect as a dramatic director and still be utterly lacking with respect to composition.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 两本集短片每尺必用
content: 执导两本集连续短片时任务严苛，必须让每一尺胶片都发挥作用，不能有节奏浪费。
quote: The severe task faced by the director of the two reel episode serial and how he must make every foot of film count

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 大场面推向情感高潮
content: 把主要人物的短促镜头插入大场面之中，可将大场面的震撼感推向情感高潮，而不是让奇观单独消耗掉情绪。
quote: And the glimpses shown of them brought the thrills of the big scenes to a tremendous emotional climax.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 创作者是画蓝图的人
content: 把分镜编剧类比为建筑蓝图与造船图纸的绘制者：真正的创作者是制定计划的人，导演与施工者只是执行者，因此分镜阶段决定成片形态。
quote: The creators are the men who draw up the plans.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 首尾镜呼应作支点
content: 把告别段落与开场镜头建立呼应关系，使二者构成全片的核心概念支点，用首尾结构锚定影片的空间命题。
quote: the farewell sequence is intimately connected to the film’s opening shot, which may be considered one of its central conceptual pivots.

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 内外空间的叠加
content: 把外部景观与人物内心叠加：风景作为路线图，村庄作为迷宫与镜像场所，用空间映射人物灵魂。
quote: His landscapes are road maps, but villages are labyrinths and mirror places, portraits of someone’s soul.

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 夜戏作为空间逻辑
content: 把夜戏当作概念性阈限而非单纯背景：夜用于打断线性与空间连贯性，日则承载连续与累积；若影片主体是日间日常，可用一段夜戏开场，以两种空间逻辑的对立建立感知框架。
quote: night is not the backdrop for action but a principle of fragmentation – a disruption of linear and spatial coherence.

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 气泡式封闭空间
content: 把影片空间处理成一连串气泡般的封闭围合，使整体空间既被包裹又略带幽闭感，而非开放连续的环境。
quote: this space is not only encapsulated and slightly claustrophobic – composed of a series of bubble-like enclosures

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 软迷宫：对话与记忆
content: 把心理层面的迷宫落实为延长的对话——问路、指路——或对前作记忆的召回，用言语往复替代空间移动来表现困局。
quote: The latter manifests through extended dialogues – asking directions, guiding conversations – or recalling memories from previous films

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 前后场次的时间定位
content: 把更衣/脱衣这类私密段落安排在斗牛前后，作为事件之间的过渡时刻，用缓慢的互动与极少台词承载节奏。
quote: the hotel episodes occur either before or after the bullfight – moments of dressing or undressing

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 硬迷宫：道路与障碍
content: 把物理层面的迷宫落实为道路与障碍的组合，让主角沿同一路径反复行走却始终到不了最初目标，用实景路径制造迷失感。
quote: the physical (roads and obstacles, the “hard labyrinth”)

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 移动的家而非家庭片
content: 把车处理成“移动的室内”：在外部空间中携带一个可移动的内部，使镜头在广阔外景里始终保有一个封闭的内部视点。
quote: He does not make home movies but moving homes – a mobile interiority within exteriority.

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 分镜定稿即完成大半
content: 把连续性脚本（分镜/场次稿）打磨到最终形态再交给导演，此时影片制作的大半工作已算完成，拍摄阶段只做执行。
quote: the greater part of the work of producing a picture has been completed when the continuity is in final shape to hand to the director

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 拳击球式原地运动
content: 把镜头/段落的运动比作被反复击打却停在原地的拳击球：持续施力但不产生位移，用这种'动而不进'的调度制造单调与不透明感。
quote: a boxing ball, which gets hit all the time yet remains in place

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 机关道具制造喜剧动作
content: 拍喜剧中的滑稽动作（如食物总在入口前弹开）时，用钢丝、弹簧等机关道具控制物体运动轨迹，而非依赖演员即兴，以保证每次拍摄效果一致。
quote: Of course there are such things as wires and springs.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 节奏决定喜剧成败
content: 拍喜剧时，节奏的精确把控可“成就”或“毁掉”一部片子：必须严格关注配时，忽视节奏会直接破坏喜剧效果。
quote: how comedy pictures can be “made” or “broken” through close attention to this angle of production, or a total disregard of it

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 仪式与斥责用慢节奏
content: 拍宗教仪式或重要的戏剧性斥责段落时，把节奏压到最慢，用慢 tempo 承载庄重与情绪重量。
quote: any such sequence as a religious ceremony or an important dramatic denunciation

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 情节剧靠情境造人物
content: 拍情节剧时，可让情境先行、由情境逼出人物性格：先设计强情境，再让角色在其中的反应定义其性格，而非先立人物再找戏。
quote: Situations created character, true to the rule of melodrama.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 镜面增殖制造困惑
content: 拍房间时用巨型旅馆镜面把影像多重反射、增殖成一组令人困惑的画面，以镜像的重复取代清晰的空间交代。
quote: the room, presenting a series of confusing images multiplied by giant hotel mirrors

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 近景拳击用轻触
content: 拍拳头击中下巴的近景时，演员只轻拍对手，靠镜头与剪辑制造猛烈冲击感，不真打。
quote: Then there is the close shot of the hero's fist landing with terrific impact on the villain's jaw and sending him sprawling.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 小细节与大动作同等重要
content: 拍摄奇观段落时，导演不能忽视其中的细小元素（人物反应、局部动作），这些小细节与群众大动作同等关键。
quote: he never loses sight of the little things of the spectacle, they are as vitally important as the mass action itself.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 用音乐给演员定情绪
content: 拍摄情绪戏（悲情、情感戏）时，在片场播放与场景情绪相符的音乐，帮助演员进入正确表演状态；音乐比口头指导更能让演员入戏。
quote: Music, more than all the advice and coaching that a director may give his company, serves to cast them in the proper mood for a scene.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 自然景作为凝视主体
content: 拍摄自然/乡村场景时，不要把风景当被动背景板；让环境成为视觉话语的主动参与者，在观察者与被观察环境之间建立互惠关系（如让景物的运动、光线变化回应人物视线）。
quote: nature and landscapes inherently embody the question of gaze – they are not passive backdrops but active participants in visual discourse

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 伪装角色需防真同行识破
content: 拍摄警察等职业角色时，若在真实街区取景，可能引来真实从业者盘问；应提前与演员约定应对方式（如告知正在拍电影并请对方不要看向摄影机），避免其转头破坏镜头。
quote: a real policeman appeared on the scene and questioned the made-up policeman as to his own identity.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 移动车舱作为空间与场所的辩证
content: 拍摄车内对话或行进段落时，把车厢处理为稳定的'场所'（固定机位、封闭构图），车外流动景观处理为'空间'（横向移动的背景）；用这种内外对比在同一镜内同时呈现运动与停顿。
quote: While traversing space, cars create a dialectic: their static cabins offer place-like stability amid spatial flow

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 滑稽戏配悲乐
content: 拍滑稽/讽刺（burlesque）场面时，可故意播放严肃戏用的缓慢悲情音乐，让演员更准确把握滑稽元素。
quote: when they are playing a burlesque scene they often call for the slow, tearful music that is used for the serious scene.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 大场面中穿插主角
content: 拍群众/奇观大场面时，必须在大场面之间插入主要人物的近景片段，让观众始终跟随个人故事线；只堆砌大场面而无戏剧目的，观众兴趣会迅速消退。
quote: But even in the midst of all these scenes of thrilling revelry the four principal characters of the picture were introduced rejoicing too.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 车内空间作为取景装置
content: 拍车内戏时，把汽车当作框定视线、中介心理空间与物理空间的 dispositif：用挡风玻璃/车窗形成画框，让车内（内）与车外（外）持续互换。
quote: with particular attention to the car as a dispositif that frames the gaze and mediates between psychological and physical space

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 喜剧节奏决定笑点成败
content: 拍轻喜剧或喜剧正剧时，把每场戏与段落的节奏校准到其应有长度；节奏稍慢或稍快都会毁掉一个本可成立的笑点，甚至让整段喜剧脱轨、无法挽回。
quote: the slightest variation from the proper tempo in one direction or the other, often spoils the effect of a possible laugh.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 分集高潮的极速节奏
content: 拍连续剧每集结尾的大高潮/大冲击场面时，动作速度要提到近乎闪电般的快，导演应把演员逼到速度极限；情节段可以按半分钟计，高潮段要按半秒计，几乎不留任何停顿。
quote: Here the action assumes almost lightning like rapidity. The director must force his players to the limit of their capacity for speed.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 连集片禁止演员静止
content: 拍连集片时，几乎不能让演员静止超过半分钟，所有人物须持续处于运动状态，由情节与动作本身驱动。
quote: He can seldom let a player stand still for the short space of a half minute. Everyone is constantly on the move.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 追逐戏节奏须统一
content: 拍追逐戏时，各镜头速度必须一致；若一场快、下一场慢，说明导演不懂如何达成所需效果，成片会显得业余。
quote: The people in the chase will go fast in one scene and slow in the next.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 追逐非只是追人
content: 拍追逐段落不能只理解为让一组人追另一组人，节奏与效果的设计才是核心工作。
quote: He probably thought doing a chase picture was the mere job of telling one bunch of people to chase another bunch of people.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 追逐戏用极快节奏
content: 拍追逐段落（喜剧或正剧，如警察追贼）时，把动作速度提到现实与可信度允许的最大值；滑稽喜剧可刻意超出真实感。
quote: the value of an ultra-rapid tempo in dealing with a chase episode

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 封闭空间去地理化
content: 拍酒店房间等封闭内景时，不拍窗户、不给任何可辨识地理位置的标志物，把空间处理成密封胶囊，让观众无法定位外部世界。
quote: treated in a similar manner as sealed capsules: no windows are shown, nor any clear geographical indication

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 实拍惊险替代特效
content: 拍高空惊险场面时，优先让演员在真实高处实拍（如高楼边缘梦游），而非用假景或特效伪造，以取得更真实的惊悚效果。
quote: preferring instead to accomplish the actual thrill

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 中途叫停要彻底讲清
content: 排练中若演员动作不对，可在场景中途叫停，把问题彻底讲清楚再继续，而不是放任演完。
quote: You call a halt in the middle of a scene and explain matters thoroughly to them.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 先讲戏再排练
content: 排练前先向不熟悉场面的演员（如管家、女仆）说明各自动作与走位，再开始整段排练，避免中途反复叫停。
quote: You explain the parts to the butler and the maid who perhaps are not familiar with the scene. Then you do start.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 复制作为意义媒介
content: 机械复制在电影空间中不只是生产手段，而成为形式与媒介，生成新的感知方式；因此复制本身即具美学与符号学功能。
quote: such representations act “not as a productive force but as medium as form and principle of a whole new generation of sense”

source_ref.title: Blurring Space Across Film, Theatre and Virtual Reality: Zero Calorie Restaurant (2023)
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 主角前置放大
content: 构图时把不可替代的主角始终放在前景，并使其在画面中比其他人更大，用象征性而非写实的比例建立等级关系。
quote: The irreplaceable protagonist is always positioned in the foreground

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 按戏剧分量配节奏
content: 每场戏的节奏应与其戏剧分量成比例：分量越重节奏越慢，分量越轻节奏越快，全片节奏随戏剧价值起伏变化。
quote: other scenes of varying dramatic calibre should be keyed to rates of tempo of varying and relative importance

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 演员动作时长即节奏
content: 演员出房间走得太慢或太快、面部表情变化过快或过慢，都会破坏戏剧或喜剧效果；导演须持续盯表演以纠正这类节奏失误。
quote: A player can spoil a dramatic or comedy effect by taking too much time to walk out of a room or going out of it too quickly.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 导演须隐藏慌乱
content: 现场延误、进度落后时导演不能显露慌乱，否则全组会嘲笑、失去权威；保持镇定是维持调度权的前提。
quote: Still you mustn't become obviously flustered. If you did the whole company would give you a laugh

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 循环结构制造预期落空
content: 用循环/重复的段落结构组织影片时，让观众预期变化却始终不给叙事推进，以此把'可预测'的形式转化为'不可预测'的观看体验。
quote: The viewer anticipates change – but it never comes.

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 无线麦消除环境声
content: 用无线麦克风近距离拾音、剔除环境底噪，只保留人声与细微声响；车内戏不录城市与车辆声，酒店戏保留台词间的静默，以声音的封闭感强化空间的幽闭与孤立。
quote: wireless microphones are employed to eliminate ambient noise and capture sounds imperceptible to the human ear.

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 以疏离感替代叙事快感
content: 用疏离与不适感作为吸引观众的手段，而非依赖情节推进；这种不透明性构成作品的先锋性，同时也会让部分观众产生怀疑与离场。
quote: engages some viewers through estrangement and discomfort, while logically provoking scepticism in others

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 蜿蜒路径叠加虚构与纪实
content: 用蜿蜒曲折的路径把艺术叠加到自然、把虚构叠加到纪实之上，使同一条路既像被安排的场面又像被记录的现实。
keywords: 蜿蜒路径叠加虚构与纪实
quote: how winding paths in Kiarostami’s films function to superimpose art onto nature and fiction onto documentary

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 道路作为记忆的刻痕
content: 用道路与路径的影像承载'旅程记忆'：车不断遗忘走过的路，而道路本身成为大地刻下的记忆，可在转场或空镜中用路面、路径的持续影像替代车辆来保留行程痕迹。
quote: Roads and paths, by contrast, become the earth’s engraved memories of journeys taken.

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 镜中自照的双重构图
content: 用镜子同时框住人物与其自身影像，使人物与自己的镜像构成画面内的双重关系，而非单纯记录动作。
quote: The mirror not only frames Roca Rey in interaction with his own image

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 画面美感是导演功绩
content: 画面的绘画性美感应被当作导演的创作成果来经营，而非仅靠布景或摄影偶然获得。
quote: PICTORIAL BEAUTY WAS A DIRECTORIAL ACHIEVEMENT DISPLAYED IN “THE FOUR HORSEMEN”

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 中心站位加正面朝向
content: 确立叙事焦点时，把主角放在画面中心，并让他成为唯一正对镜头的人物，其他角色侧身或背向，用朝向差异标记谁是叙事中心。
quote: Mr. Gao is placed in the centre of the frame and is the only character who directly faces the camera, marking him as the narrative focus.

source_ref.title: Blurring Space Across Film, Theatre and Virtual Reality: Zero Calorie Restaurant (2023)
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 侧光bank的位置确认
content: 确认侧向大面积光源（bank，即从布景侧面整体灌入的移动灯组）是否摆放在正确位置；开拍前与摄影指导和灯光师共同核对，不能含糊。
quote: Are the “banks” in the right place? (Of course, you know that a “bank” is the moving mass of light that is flooded in from the side of the setting).

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 摄影机转速决定节奏
content: 节奏还取决于摄影机的拍摄转速：摄影师懂行可自行掌控全片 tempo，不懂则会在导演努力之外毁掉整片的场面时间感。
quote: A cameraman can manage the tempo of a picture by himself if he knows sufficiently

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 节奏即各段落的配时
content: 节奏（tempo）指导演对构成影片的各段落做恰当的时间分配与配时，属导演技术层面；剪辑与场面长度须按此统一安排。
quote: it means the “timing,” or rather the proper timing of the various episodes that constitute the picture.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 艺术指导与导演分工
content: 若导演不擅长构图与画面构成，应让艺术指导与戏剧导演在每一场（内景或外景）共同工作，由艺术指导负责构图与视觉设计，导演专注表演与叙事。
quote: there should be, and doubtless will be in time, an art director working along with the dramatic director on every scene, interior or exterior.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 失去视角导致跳切
content: 若导演因过度熟悉素材而丧失新鲜视角，成片会显得跳跃、缺乏连贯性；因此剪辑时以观众首次观看的认知为准来检查镜头衔接。
quote: This loss of perspective is one of the reasons why we have 'jumpy' pictures and pictures that seem lacking in continuity.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 调整机位后重调灯光
content: 若导演坚持把摄影机移近或移远，机位变动后必须相应微调灯位，重新确认布光，不能只改机位不管灯。
quote: This, of course, necessitates a slight change in the position of the lights again which, of course, you attend to.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 导演可依剧本执行
content: 若导演未参与编剧，仍可仅依据作者定稿的剧本完成有艺术价值的影片；舞台导演常如此，电影导演亦可照此定位自身职能。
quote: many and many a stage director has turned out productions of artistic worth by merely following the author's manuscript

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 去时空聚焦人物
content: 若想强调动作的无时间性，可刻意淡化“何地何时”的信息，把观众注意力转移到“何人”上。
quote: to shift the viewer’s attention away from the questions of where and when, toward who

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 节奏失当致剪辑困境
content: 若拍摄时对节奏关注不足，导演在剪辑阶段会陷入无从下手的困境，因为素材本身的时间感已错。
quote: Lack of proper attention to tempo often results in a director finding himself at a loss when it comes to cutting his picture.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 只拍车内不拍外观
content: 若要让空间显得既过渡又孤立，可始终只呈现车厢内部、从不给车辆外观镜头；移动感仅靠窗外掠过的公交、地铁站等零星城市元素暗示。
quote: The van is never shown from the outside; we only see its interior

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 碎片化空间阻断空间地图
content: 若要让观众无法建立连贯空间地图，就大量使用特写并取消清晰的定场镜头，使同一场景与不同场景难以区分。
quote: the predominance of close-ups and the absence of clear establishing shots prevent the viewer from constructing a coherent spatial map

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 反高潮与去故事化
content: 若采用慢电影/极简手法，可刻意安排反高潮时刻并取消故事线，让影像停留在'存在'而非'行动'上，用停顿替代事件。
quote: such as moments of anticlimax and the absence of storytelling

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 从放映效果反推拍摄
content: 若音乐在成片放映时能显著提升效果，则同样可在拍摄阶段用音乐提升表演质量——把放映端的经验迁移到制作端。
quote: if music can be employed to such benefit in the exhibition of a picture, it can be employed to equal benefit in the production of it.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 中间空间式取景
content: 营造介于抽象与感官现实之间的中间空间时，让景物既非纯抽象也非纯写实，使物质被去物质化、精神被肉身化，避免把超验世界处理成凌驾于现实之上的另一层空间。
quote: this intermediary realm exists between abstraction and sensory reality, where “matter is immaterialized and spirit corporealized”

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 废墟裂缝作为生成性虚空
content: 表现地震等空间破坏事件时，把产生的裂缝与裂隙拍成不只是障碍，而是美学中必要的生成性虚空，让破坏同时成为新空间的起点。
keywords: 废墟裂缝作为生成性虚空
quote: creates cracks and fissures that are not just obstacles but necessary generative voids within his aesthetic

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 蜿蜒路径的构图母题
content: 表现自然景观时，可用蜿蜒曲折的路径穿过单色（如黄色调）山坡、通向一棵孤立的开花树，以路径的蛇形走向引导视线并构成画面纵深。
quote: depicting a winding, serpentine path cutting through a yellow-toned hillside, leading to a solitary flowering tree

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 长镜头揭示空间尺度
content: 要表现空间的巨大与威胁感，用异常延长的单镜头让人物横穿整个空间，把场地的辽阔、暴露一次性交代出来。
quote: the unexpectedly prolonged duration of the shot, which for the first time reveals the arena as truly vast, exposed, and threatening

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 双曝光造水上行走
content: 要让角色看起来在水面行走，可用双重曝光合成；但仅知道手法不足以复现，还需配套的拍摄与合成控制。
quote: One can hazard the guess that he makes a comedian appear to be walking on water by double exposure

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 重复说服作为迷宫母题
content: 让主角反复尝试说服同一类对象（如说服乘客协助自杀），用同一动作的多次重复构成心理迷宫的可见形态。
keywords: 重复说服作为迷宫母题
quote: the repetitive attempts to convince passengers to assist the protagonist’s suicide in Taste of Cherry

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 先提问后观看的解毒过程
content: 让主角起初先发问、后观看与理解，再逐步被村庄的各类谜题扰动，最终摆脱固有的聚焦式观看与倾听习惯。
quote: this man – who begins by asking questions before taking the time to look and understand – will allow himself to be disturbed by the enigmas

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 重复迷宫式旅程的液化
content: 让主角进行重复的、迷宫式的旅程，以此侵蚀其僵硬的、土性的固着，把叙事运动从固态转向水的流动性。
keywords: 重复迷宫式旅程的液化
quote: a process enacted by the protagonists’ repetitive, labyrinthine journeys that erode their rigid, earth-like fixations

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 人物与迷宫村庄对置
content: 让主角隐秘的行事方式与诡计式方法，与迷宫般的村庄和盘旋道路形成对置，用环境结构反衬人物方法。
quote: the secretive manner and tricky methods of Behzad is set against a labyrinthine village and spiralling roads

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 直视镜头建立对视
content: 让公牛与斗牛士都以正面视角直视观众，用打破第四面墙的对视把人物从叙事中抽离，形成孤立而神话化的注视关系。
quote: the nocturnal figure of the bull, looking directly at the viewer; the van, with a frontal view of the torero, who also gazes at us

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 循环重复的时间结构
content: 让时间动态呈循环、重复的形态，与神话的总体逻辑呼应，用重复取代线性推进来组织段落节奏。
quote: its temporal dynamics are also cyclical and repetitive, echoing the general logic of myth

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 静动/圣俗的视觉呼应
content: 让静止的装饰物（如圣像头巾）与运动的人物服装在造型上呼应，使神圣与奇观、静与动在画面中互相渗透。
quote: the ornamental mantle on the Virgin’s head visually resonates with the bullfighter’s costume, creating a remarkable visual parallel

source_ref.title: The Logic of Disorientation: Exploring Space in Albert Serra's Afternoons of Solitude
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 群众反应需按真实心理预估
content: 设计群众对倒地人物的反应时，不能假设路人会冷漠或厌恶；实际拍摄中路人更可能出于好奇围观，因此分镜应预留群众驻足、询问的表演空间，而非只安排他们径直走过。
quote: It was thought that the majority of folk regarded such figures with antipathy. Instead they were interested.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 喜剧导演的艺术地位
content: 评论默片时，不应只把闹剧/打闹喜剧当作正片后的附赠品一笔带过；打闹喜剧导演的创作（如 Sennett 式喜剧）在艺术性与创造力上可与正剧导演同等甚至更高地严肃评价。
quote: this branch of production is an art too and a very high one and one to be taken just as seriously if not more so than the art of dramatic production.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 快慢场景的表演速度
content: 该快节奏的场景在棚内按正常速度演；为强调某个强烈戏剧点而放慢的场景，通常要比正常呈现速度再慢一点演。
quote: these scenes are as a rule played a little bit slower than they would normally be presented.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 连集片信息密度高于长片
content: 连集片在两本篇幅内要讲完不亚于五本长片的故事量，因此导演必须持续保持动作高速推进，不能靠拉长段落来叙事。
quote: Often in the two reels allowed him he must tell as much if not more story than is usually told in the five reel feature.

source_ref.title: Motion Picture Directing: The Facts and Theories of the Newest Art
source_ref.author: Milne, Peter, 1896-1968

title: 长镜头换视角揭示全景
content: 需要从局部过渡到整体空间时，用一个长镜头在同一镜内改变视角：先给局部特写，再拉开露出左中右三层信息（左侧食客、中央主角、背景服务员），避免切碎空间。
quote: This verisimilitude continues with a long take that shifts perspectives, revealing a fuller view of the space

source_ref.title: Blurring Space Across Film, Theatre and Virtual Reality: Zero Calorie Restaurant (2023)
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal

title: 孤树定关键地点
content: 需要让观众记住某个关键地点（如墓地、村庄）时，用一棵孤树作为该地点的视觉标识，把地点信息绑定在同一个反复出现的形象上。
quote: identifies key spatial markers: the grave’s location in Taste of Cherry, and the village’s location in The Wind Will Carry Us

source_ref.title: Geology of Ideas, Hydrology of Matter: Nature and Space in Abbas Kiarostami's Cinema
source_ref.author: Frames Cinema Journal
